sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: An ISRC segment entry in the 📊 dropdown ("» country: QM" and the registrant/year/designation entries) that exists only inside a COLLAPSED list item now carries a ▶ marker and a tooltip saying so. Such entries are still offered — ticking one still shows the row and tints the ▶ toggle — the marker just explains why nothing on screen shows the code yet. Expanding the cell drops the marker — `_isCollapsedHiddenItem()`, `collapsedOnlyKeys`.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Ticking an ISRC segment entry ("» country: GB", registrant, year, designation) filtered correctly but marked nothing. `initIsrcFormatting()` ran after the highlight and rebuilt every `<code>`, wiping the mark, and on a multi-table page the highlight ran on an unformatted clone with no segment spans to scope to. `_formatIsrcAnchor()` is now idempotent (an already-formatted `<code>` is left alone) and `_formatIsrcAnchorsIn()` formats a clone before it is matched.
"» year: 2005" could never mark anything: the entry value is the 4-digit year but the cell displays the 2-digit "05". The highlighter now marks the displayed segment.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Ticking "valid ISWC format" (and, the same omission, "valid ISRC format" and "valid barcode format") narrowed the rows but highlighted nothing — only the invalid flags had a highlighter. Added `_highlightIswcValidMatch()`, `_highlightIsrcValidMatch()` and `_highlightBarcodeValidMatch()`.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Ticking "BUMA" and then "STEMRA ID" (or any two entries that mark the same text) highlighted only the first. `highlightCrossTag()` inserted a virtual space wherever an earlier highlight had split one text node, so a regex spanning the split ("(BUMA/STEMRA ID)") read "(BUMA /STEMRA ID)" and never matched. It no longer adds a gap between two text nodes that were one node before a highlight wrapper split them. Generic to every column's multi-value highlight, not just identifier types.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The 📊 unique-values dropdown for a "Time" column (events listings) now offers a "Time info - Time of day" section with five fixed buckets — Morning (04:00-11:59), Lunch (12:00-12:59), Afternoon (13:00-17:59), Evening (18:00-23:59) and Night (00:00-03:59) — `_findCellTimeBucket()`.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: "Attributes - Identifier type" now also lists the parts of a slash-separated identifier type separately: a `BUMA/STEMRA ID` badge is offered as `BUMA/STEMRA ID`, `BUMA` and `STEMRA ID` — `_workAttrTypeLabels()`.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The 📊 dropdown for a "Length" column now offers a "Length info - Milliseconds" section: "ms ≠ .000", "ms = .000" and "no ms data". Shown only once at least one cell carries milliseconds (after ⏱) — `_findCellLengthMsState()`.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The 📊 dropdown for a "Relationship types" column now offers a "Relationship types - Credited as" section listing each `(as “credit”)` separately, prefixed with its relationship type (e.g. "» instrument as: lead guitar") — `_findCellRelTypeCredits()`.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The 📊 dropdown for a "Tracks" column now offers a "Tracks info - Total" section with the summed track count over all mediums (the same number as the synthetic "Total Tracks" column), e.g. "5 + 5 + 5" → 15.
